name: HEAVY FIRE THE CHOSEN FEW
description:
HEAVY FIRE THE CHOSEN FEW is a rail gun shooting game set in modern-day South America and Africa. The work, which has been highly praised in the United States for its high-quality images and simple operability, has finally landed in Japan.

Players take on the role of a U.S. Marine who participates in operations to wipe out guerrillas in the jungles of South America and the deserts of Africa. The operability is very simple and easy to understand, and it can be enjoyed by a wide range of users, from beginners to those who are good at shooting games.
